name: Expo
run: npx expo run:ios   (or: npx expo run:android)
leftForYou: Rebuild the app: the SDK has native code, so Expo Go cannot load it. Run 'npx expo prebuild' and then 'npx expo run:ios' or 'npx expo run:android', or make a new development build.
Connect the App Store or Google Play and map your products to store products before you sell for real: 'voidhash provider --help'. Until then, debug builds simulate purchases.
